'''Anakin Skywalker's Podracer''' was a custom-built [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]] built by a nine-year old [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] as a [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], and used to secure his freedom and the replacement [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] components for Queen Amidala's [[J-type 327 Nubian royal starship/Legends|ship]] during the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:SebulbaRadonUlzerPodracer-SWREP16.jpg|thumb|left|180px|The podracer repainted and used by Sebulba.]]
[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker's]] [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]] was constructed from a pair of [[Radon-Ulzer/Legends|Radon-Ulzer]] [[620C racing engine/Legends|620c turbines]]. One engine was put together from spare parts in [[Wald's Parts|Watto's junkyard]]. These parts included the burned-out turbines from Watto's own podracer, which Skywalker had eventually crashed. The other engine was acquired when Anakin bartered with [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]]. He modified the engines heavily, notably by improving the fuel injection system in order to increase thrust. Skywalker attached triple yellow [[Air scoop/Legends|air scoops]] to these engines to give the vehicle optimal maneuverability, especially while turning.<ref name="CCS" /> The cockpit was attached to the massive motors by [[Steelton/Legends|Steelton]] [[control cable]]s. The racer could reach breakneck speeds in the area of 947 kilometers an hour (588 mph), earning its title of the fastest podracer in the galaxy.<ref name="FF" /> It could only fit one person; the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]]. Similar to the other podracers, Anakin's podracer possessed energy binders for keeping the podracer together during the race. The energy binders, if crossed by a biological being, also have a side-effect of causing the affected body part to go numb for several hours.<ref name="SWE1" />

==History==
[[File:AnakinSkywalkersPodracerSymbol-FF2.svg|thumb|150px|Podracer symbol.]]
{{Quote|I've built a podracer. It's the fastest one ever!|Anakin Skywalker to his new friends|<ref name="SWE1 vg">[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (video game)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' video game]]</ref>}}
As a nine [[Standard year/Legends|year]]-old [[Slavery/Legends|slave]], Anakin Skywalker regularly raced a podracer that belonged to his owner, [[Watto/Legends|Watto]]. In secret, Skywalker was building his own.<ref name="SWE1" />

In the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] race in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="NEC" /> Skywalker used his podracer to defeat his archrival, [[Sebulba/Legends|Sebulba]] the [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] and win his freedom from slavery.<ref name="SWE1" /> The [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] helped repair the podracer by acquiring parts in [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]]. Just before the race started, a [[Lizard boy|thief]] stole the [[plasma ignition capacitor]]. Jinn chased the thief and discovered that the part was held by a [[Scavenger (Mos Espa)|scavenger]]. Jinn defeated the [[Alien/Legends|alien]] and returned the part to Skywalker.<ref name="SWE1 vg" />

After the race, [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] sold the pod to Sebulba, who repainted the vehicle orange and used it himself to qualify for the [[Vinta Harvest Classic/Legends|Vinta Harvest Classic]], lifting the suspension he received following the Boonta. Eventually, the Dug passed it on to his son, [[Hekula]]. Hekula crashed the racer in an illegal [[Great Dordon Caves|Caves]] race on the planet [[Euceron]] during the [[Galactic Games/Legends|Galactic Games]] of [[26 BBY/Legends|26 BBY]], nearly destroying it (but participating also was Anakin Skywalker, who once again defeated a Dug and won the race). The podracer was duly abandoned. Skywalker later reacquired the vehicle and again pitted it against Sebulba in one last rematch.

During [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], when the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] was intensifying, a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] acquired a podracer that looked very similar to Skywalker's. This podracer was believed to be a mere replica, and not the same vehicle piloted by Skywalker.

==Behind the scenes==
The podracer first appeared in [[1999]]'s [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']] and its tie-ins. The podracer was reimagined in LEGO form as a drivable vehicle in the [[2005]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Video Game]]'' and its [[2007]] [[LEGO Star Wars: The Complete Saga|compilation re-release]].
